title: NordvikManager action
description: A file in an addon's Actions/ folder: a list of steps the GM's server runs. See https://nordvikmanager.pl/addon-guide/actions/overview

permission.description: Permission flags, added together: None=0, Read=1, Execute=2, Control=4, Edit=8, Remove=16, All=31.

id.description: Optional step id, shown in errors and the debugger.

Type.description: The step's name, e.g. RollDice, SetProperty, RunScript. Every step is listed at https://nordvikmanager.pl/addon-guide/actions/steps

Data.description: The step's arguments. Values may contain tokens such as %cardId% or %roll.result%.

prefix.title: Prefix
prefix.description: Replaced with the addon's key on install, so it can be left out.

path.title: Folder
path.description: Folder shown in the action editor.

hook.title: Hook
hook.description: What triggers the action; 0 for none (called by name). 1 Install, 2 Uninstall, 3 Player Join, 4 Player Leave, 5 Player Load, 6 Element Added, 7 Element Updated, 8 Element Moved, 9 Element Removed, 10 Property Added, 11 Property Updated, 12 Property Removed, 13 Map Added, 14 Map Updated, 15 Map Removed, 16 Map Changed, 17 Game Updated, 18 Chat Message, 19 Chat Command, 20 Card Added, 21 Card Updated, 22 Card Deleted, 23 Turn Changed. See https://nordvikmanager.pl/addon-guide/actions/hooks

isEnabled.title: Enabled
isEnabled.description: Addon actions are always enabled on install; this value is ignored there.

genericPermission.title: Everyone's permission
genericPermission.description: What every player may do with the action. Permission flags: None=0, Read=1, Execute=2, Control=4, Edit=8, Remove=16, All=31.

gmPermission.title: GM's permission
gmPermission.description: Permission flags: None=0, Read=1, Execute=2, Control=4, Edit=8, Remove=16, All=31.

content.title: Steps
content.description: The steps, run top to bottom. A JSON string holding the same array is also accepted.
